# New renderings chosen in iliad-074 (Iliad 12.182–276)

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| τὸν δ’ ἄρ’ ὑπόδρα ἰδὼν προσέφη κορυθαίολος Ἕκτωρ (12.230, whole-line reply-formula) | "Him then with a scowl looking addressed Hector of the glancing helmet:" | "Then Hector of the glancing helmet, looking at him with a scowl, spoke to him:" | "answered" (reserved for ἠμείβετο); built on the table's τὸν δ’ ἄρ’ ὑπόδρα ἰδὼν προσέφη … rows (4.411, 5.888, 8.165) with κορυθαίολος "of the glancing helmet" (2.816) |
| φοινήεις (δράκοντα φοινήεντα πέλωρον, 12.202, 12.220) | "blood-red" | "blood-red" | "bloody", "crimson" (kept for φοῖνιξ, φοινικόεις), "red" alone, "gory" (each decides between colour and slaughter, which the note leaves open); φοῖνιξ "crimson" is the likely root; the table’s δαφοινός (2.308) is also "blood-red", and the two are told apart by the Greek in the note, not by a second English word |
| δράκων · ὄφις (12.202, 12.208) | "serpent" · "serpent" | "serpent" · "serpent" | "snake" (kept plain for the animal in similes), "dragon"; both words are "serpent" because the poet uses them of the one creature |
| τανυπτέρυξ (οἰωνοῖσι τανυπτερύγεσσι, 12.237) | "long-winged" | "long-winged" | "wide-winged", "outstretched-winged", "with outspread wings"; τανυ- "stretched, long" + πτέρυξ "wing" |
| θεοπρόπος (12.228) | "diviner" | "diviner" | "seer" (kept for μάντις), "prophet", "soothsayer"; θεοπρόπος is one who declares the gods' will, and θεοπροπίον stays "prophecy" |
| ὑποκρίνομαι (ὑποκρίναιτο, of an omen, 12.228) | "interpret" | "interpret" | "answer" (the table's ὑποκρίνονται, 7.407, and the Odyssey's 2.111); a departure, because the object is a sign, which is not answered but explained |
| μερμηρίζω (μερμήριζον, 12.199) | "were in doubt" | "were in doubt between two courses" | "in two minds", "ponder" (reserved for ὁρμαίνω), "debate", "waver"; follows the table’s διάνδιχα μερμήριξεν (1.189) "was in doubt between two courses", the `i` carrying the two courses the verb implies |
| ἐπιπλήσσω (12.211) | "chide" | "chide" | "rebuke" (kept for νεικέω and ἐνίπτω), "scold", "reproach" (kept for ὀνειδίζω) |
| νεικέω (νείκεον, 12.268; imperfect, present system) | "rebuke" | "rebuke" | "reproach" (kept for ὀνειδίζω), "chide" (kept for ἐπιπλήσσω), "revile" (the aorists); follows the table’s νεικέω present system "rebuke" (1.521, 2.221–277); not a new rendering, listed because the first draft departed from it |
| μενεδήϊος (κραδίη μενεδήϊος, 12.247; μένω "stand firm" + δήϊος "hostile") | "foe-withstanding" | "one to stand firm against the enemy" | "steadfast" alone, "brave", "stout-hearted" (kept for the θυμός words); the note gives the parts |
| μαχήμων (12.247) | "fight-ready" | "ready to fight" | "warlike" (kept for ἀρήϊος), "combative", "fond of battle" |
| ἐέργω (λαὸν ἐέργων, of the eagle, 12.201 = 12.219) | "keeping the people shut off" | "barring the army's way" | "driving back", "herding", "keeping off the host" ("host" is avoided for λαός); the note says the exact picture is not given. λαός is "people" in `l` and "army" in `i`, as in the table |
| κελευτιάω (κελευτιόωντ’, 12.265, dual participle) | "giving orders" | "giving their orders" | "urging on" (reserved for ὀτρύνω), "cheering on", "exhorting"; a form built on κελεύω, which is "bid" / "give orders" in the table |
